rectangle.example_en: The architect drew a rectangle around the garden on the plan.
rectangle.example_zh: 建筑师在平面图上绕着花园画了一个长方形。

referee.example_en: After a long argument, the referee stopped the match and awarded a free kick.
referee.example_zh: 一番长时间的争执之后，裁判员中止了比赛并判罚任意球。

religion.example_en: Freedom of religion is protected by law in this country.
religion.example_zh: 在这个国家，宗教自由受法律保护。

religious.example_en: Many religious festivals bring families together every year.
religious.example_zh: 许多宗教节日每年都会让家人团聚。

resemble.example_en: The twins resemble each other so closely that strangers often mix them up.
resemble.example_zh: 这对双胞胎长得太像了，陌生人常常把他们认错。

reservation.example_en: Please confirm your reservation at the hotel before six this evening.
reservation.example_zh: 请在今晚六点前确认你的酒店预订。

resist.example_en: She could not resist the smell of fresh bread from the bakery.
resist.example_zh: 她无法抗拒面包店里新鲜面包的香味。

restriction.example_en: A new restriction on parking will take effect next Monday.
restriction.example_zh: 一项新的停车限制将于下周一生效。

revolution.example_en: The industrial revolution changed how people worked and lived.
revolution.example_zh: 工业革命改变了人们的工作和生活方式。

rid.example_en: We must rid the kitchen of mice before the guests arrive.
rid.example_zh: 我们必须在客人到来之前清除厨房里的老鼠。

ridiculous.example_en: Wearing sandals in deep snow looks completely ridiculous.
ridiculous.example_zh: 在深雪里穿凉鞋看起来十分荒唐。

ripen.example_en: These tomatoes will ripen faster if you leave them on the sunny windowsill.
ripen.example_zh: 如果把这些番茄放在向阳的窗台上，它们会熟得更快。

rooster.example_en: A rooster crowed loudly behind the barn just at sunrise.
rooster.example_zh: 日出时分，一只公鸡在谷仓后面大声啼叫。

rot.example_en: Fruit left in a damp cellar will soon rot.
rot.example_zh: 放在潮湿地窖里的水果很快就会腐烂。

roundabout.example_en: Drivers must slow down before they enter the roundabout near the station.
roundabout.example_zh: 司机驶入车站附近的环岛之前必须减速。

sacred.example_en: That mountain is sacred to the people who have lived nearby for centuries.
sacred.example_zh: 那座山对世世代代住在附近的人们来说是神圣的。

sacrifice.example_en: Parents often sacrifice their own comfort for their children's future.
sacrifice.example_zh: 父母常常为了孩子的未来牺牲自己的舒适。

salute.example_en: Soldiers salute the national flag every morning in the square.
salute.example_zh: 士兵们每天早晨在广场上向国旗敬礼。

scan.example_en: Please scan the barcode on the box before you leave the shop.
scan.example_zh: 离开商店之前，请先扫描盒子上的条形码。

scar.example_en: A thin scar still shows clearly on his left cheek.
scar.example_zh: 他的左脸颊上仍清晰地留着一道细疤。

sceptical.example_en: Scientists remained sceptical until the experiment was repeated successfully.
sceptical.example_zh: 在实验被成功重复之前，科学家们一直持怀疑态度。

scholar.example_en: The young scholar published a paper on ancient Chinese poetry.
scholar.example_zh: 这位年轻学者发表了一篇关于中国古代诗歌的论文。

schoolboy.example_en: A schoolboy ran across the playground with a football under his arm.
schoolboy.example_zh: 一个男生腋下夹着足球跑过操场。

schoolgirl.example_en: The schoolgirl practised the piano for an hour after dinner.
schoolgirl.example_zh: 这个女生晚饭后练了一小时钢琴。

scold.example_en: Do not scold the child in front of his friends.
scold.example_zh: 不要当着孩子朋友的面责骂他。

seashell.example_en: She picked up a pink seashell and held it gently to her ear.
seashell.example_zh: 她捡起一枚粉色的海贝壳，轻轻贴在耳边。

seaweed.example_en: Dark seaweed covered the rocks after the tide went out.
seaweed.example_zh: 退潮之后，深色的海藻覆盖在岩石上。

selfish.example_en: Keeping the last piece of cake for himself seemed selfish.
selfish.example_zh: 把最后一块蛋糕留给自己，显得很自私。

semicircle.example_en: The children sat in a semicircle and listened to the story.
semicircle.example_zh: 孩子们坐成半圆听故事。

seminar.example_en: Next Friday's seminar will focus on climate change and cities.
seminar.example_zh: 下周五的研讨会将聚焦气候变化与城市。

separation.example_en: A long separation from his family made the sailor deeply lonely.
separation.example_zh: 与家人的长期分离让这位水手深感孤独。

shabby.example_en: His shabby coat had worn holes at both elbows.
shabby.example_zh: 他那件破旧外套的两个肘部都磨出了洞。

shortcoming.example_en: Impatience is her main shortcoming as a team leader.
shortcoming.example_zh: 缺乏耐心是她作为团队负责人的主要缺点。

shrink.example_en: Wool sweaters may shrink if you wash them in very hot water.
shrink.example_zh: 羊毛衫如果用很热的水洗，可能会缩水。

side road.example_en: We turned onto a quiet side road to avoid the traffic.
side road.example_zh: 我们拐上一条安静的支路，好避开堵车。

sidewalk.example_en: Ice on the sidewalk made the walk to school dangerous.
sidewalk.example_zh: 人行道上的冰让步行上学变得危险。

sideways.example_en: The truck slid sideways on the icy road and hit the fence.
sideways.example_zh: 卡车在结冰的路上向一侧滑去，撞上了围栏。

sigh.example_en: He would sigh whenever the bus arrived late again.
sigh.example_zh: 每当公共汽车又晚点时，他就会叹气。

sightseeing.example_en: We spent the whole morning sightseeing around the old town.
sightseeing.example_zh: 我们整个上午都在老城区观光。

significance.example_en: Few people understood the significance of that discovery at first.
significance.example_zh: 起初很少有人理解那项发现的意义。

simplify.example_en: Can you simplify these instructions so beginners can follow them easily?
simplify.example_zh: 你能把这些说明简化一下，好让初学者容易照做吗？

skilful.example_en: A skilful cook can turn simple ingredients into a fine meal.
skilful.example_zh: 熟练的厨师能把简单的食材做成一顿美餐。

skyscraper.example_en: A glass skyscraper rose high above the older buildings downtown.
skyscraper.example_zh: 一座玻璃摩天大楼高高耸立在市中心较老的建筑之上。

slave.example_en: The novel describes the hard life of a slave on a cotton farm.
slave.example_zh: 这部小说描写了一个奴隶在棉花农场的艰苦生活。

slavery.example_en: Historians say slavery was abolished there during the nineteenth century.
slavery.example_zh: 历史学家说，那里的奴隶制在十九世纪被废除。

sleeve.example_en: She rolled up one sleeve before she started washing the dishes.
sleeve.example_zh: 她开始洗碗之前先卷起了一只袖子。

slight.example_en: There is only a slight chance of rain later this afternoon.
slight.example_zh: 今天下午晚些时候下雨的可能性很小。

sneaker.example_en: His left sneaker came untied halfway through the long race.
sneaker.example_zh: 长跑进行到一半时，他左脚运动鞋的鞋带松了。

sob.example_en: The little boy began to sob when his red balloon flew away.
sob.example_zh: 小男孩的红气球飞走时，他开始抽泣。

socket.example_en: The lamp will not light unless you plug it into the wall socket.
socket.example_zh: 除非把插头插进墙上的插座，否则这盏灯不会亮。

souvenir.example_en: I bought a small souvenir for my grandmother at the night market.
souvenir.example_zh: 我在夜市给祖母买了一件小纪念品。

sparrow.example_en: A sparrow hopped along the wooden fence, looking for crumbs.
sparrow.example_zh: 一只麻雀沿着木篱笆跳着找面包屑。

spear.example_en: Hunters once used a long wooden spear to catch fish in shallow rivers.
spear.example_zh: 猎人们曾经用长木矛在浅河里捕鱼。

spin.example_en: Watch the wooden top spin until it slowly falls onto its side.
spin.example_zh: 看这个木陀螺旋转，直到它慢慢侧倒。

spiritual.example_en: Good music can meet a spiritual need that money never will.
spiritual.example_zh: 好的音乐能满足金钱永远无法满足的精神需要。

split.example_en: We should split the taxi fare equally among the four of us.
split.example_zh: 我们四个人应当均摊出租车费。

spokesman.example_en: During the briefing, the spokesman denied any link to the rumor.
spokesman.example_zh: 在情况通报会上，发言人否认与该传言有任何关联。

spokeswoman.example_en: A spokeswoman for the hospital said the injured patient was recovering.
spokeswoman.example_zh: 医院的一位女发言人说，受伤的病人正在康复。

spray.example_en: Gardeners spray the roses early in the morning to keep insects away.
spray.example_zh: 园丁一清早给玫瑰喷药，以防虫害。

squeeze.example_en: You should squeeze fresh lemon juice over the fish before serving it.
squeeze.example_zh: 上菜之前，你应该把新鲜柠檬汁挤在鱼上。

squirrel.example_en: A squirrel raced up the oak tree with a nut held in its mouth.
squirrel.example_zh: 一只松鼠嘴里叼着坚果，飞快地爬上了橡树。

stable.example_en: The ladder is not stable enough on this uneven ground.
stable.example_zh: 这架梯子在不平的地面上不够稳。

stain.example_en: Coffee left a dark stain on the white tablecloth.
stain.example_zh: 咖啡在白色桌布上留下了一块深色污渍。

stainless.example_en: This stainless steel knife will not rust in the dishwasher.
stainless.example_zh: 这把不锈钢刀放在洗碗机里也不会生锈。

starvation.example_en: The charity works hard to prevent starvation after a major flood.
starvation.example_zh: 这家慈善机构在大洪水之后努力防止人们挨饿。

statesman.example_en: The respected statesman urged both sides to return to peace talks.
statesman.example_zh: 这位德高望重的政治家敦促双方回到和谈上来。

stateswoman.example_en: As a stateswoman, she argued for fair laws and open public debate.
stateswoman.example_zh: 作为女政治家，她力争公平的法律和公开的辩论。

steward.example_en: The train steward showed us to our seats and offered tea.
steward.example_zh: 火车上的男乘务员把我们领到座位，并送来了茶。

stewardess.example_en: A stewardess offered warm blankets to passengers on the night flight.
stewardess.example_zh: 一位女乘务员给夜航班机上的乘客递上了暖和的毯子。

storage.example_en: Extra storage under the stairs holds all our camping gear.
storage.example_zh: 楼梯下方额外的储物处放着我们全部的露营装备。

stout.example_en: A stout wooden door kept the cold wind out of the cottage.
stout.example_zh: 一扇结实的木门把寒风挡在了小屋外面。

stove.example_en: She set the kettle on the stove and waited for the water to boil.
stove.example_zh: 她把水壶放在炉子上，等着水烧开。

straw.example_en: The tired horse ate dry straw from a corner of the barn.
straw.example_zh: 那匹疲惫的马吃着谷仓角落里的干稻草。

stubborn.example_en: The stubborn donkey refused to move until someone offered an apple.
stubborn.example_zh: 这头倔驴直到有人给它一只苹果才肯动。

substitute.example_en: You can substitute honey for sugar in this simple cake recipe.
substitute.example_zh: 在这个简单的蛋糕做法里，你可以用蜂蜜代替糖。

suck.example_en: Babies often suck their thumbs when they begin to feel sleepy.
suck.example_zh: 婴儿开始犯困时，常常会吮吸拇指。

suitcase.example_en: His suitcase was so heavy that he needed help on the stairs.
suitcase.example_zh: 他的手提箱太重了，上下楼梯都需要人帮忙。

suite.example_en: Their hotel suite included a bedroom, a sitting room, and a wide balcony.
suite.example_zh: 他们的酒店套房包括一间卧室、一间起居室和一个宽阳台。

sunburnt.example_en: After a whole day at the beach, her shoulders were badly sunburnt.
sunburnt.example_zh: 在海滩待了整整一天后，她的肩膀严重晒伤。

supreme.example_en: The supreme court agreed to hear the difficult case next month.
supreme.example_zh: 最高法院同意下个月审理这起棘手的案件。

surplus.example_en: The shop sold its surplus at half price on the final day.
surplus.example_zh: 商店在最后一天以半价出售剩余货物。

suspension.example_en: The suspension of local bus service lasted for three whole days.
suspension.example_zh: 当地公共汽车停运持续了整整三天。

swap.example_en: Let's swap seats so you can see the stage more clearly.
swap.example_zh: 我们换个座位吧，这样你能把舞台看得更清楚。

swear.example_en: I swear I locked the front door before we left the house.
swear.example_zh: 我发誓，我们离开房子之前我锁上了前门。

swell.example_en: My ankle began to swell soon after I twisted it on the stairs.
swell.example_zh: 我在楼梯上扭了脚踝，不久它就开始肿了。

swift.example_en: A swift reply from the company saved us a great deal of trouble.
swift.example_zh: 公司的迅速回复为我们省去了不少麻烦。

sword.example_en: The city museum displays a sword that once belonged to a general.
sword.example_zh: 市博物馆展出一把曾经属于一位将军的剑。

symptom.example_en: A high fever is often an early symptom of this illness.
symptom.example_zh: 高烧常常是这种病的早期症状。

systematic.example_en: A systematic review of the data revealed several serious errors.
systematic.example_zh: 对数据进行系统复查后，发现了几处严重错误。

taxpayer.example_en: Every taxpayer expects public money to be spent with great care.
taxpayer.example_zh: 每位纳税人都希望公共资金得到十分谨慎的使用。

technical.example_en: The repair manual is too technical for someone without special training.
technical.example_zh: 这份维修手册对没有受过专门培训的人来说太专业了。

tentative.example_en: They agreed on a tentative plan to meet again in early March.
tentative.example_zh: 他们商定了一个暂定计划，准备在三月初再次见面。

terminal.example_en: Passengers should reach the terminal at least two hours before departure.
terminal.example_zh: 乘客应至少在出发前两小时到达航站楼。

terror.example_en: The sudden loud explosion filled the narrow street with terror.
terror.example_zh: 突然的巨大爆炸使这条狭窄的街道充满了恐惧。

theoretical.example_en: His theoretical model still needs support from real experiments.
theoretical.example_zh: 他的理论模型仍需要真实实验的支持。

thermos.example_en: She poured hot tea from a thermos during the long mountain hike.
thermos.example_zh: 在漫长的山间徒步中，她从保温瓶里倒出热茶。

thrill.example_en: Winning the final gave every player on the team a huge thrill.
thrill.example_zh: 赢得决赛让队里的每一名队员都兴奋不已。

thriller.example_en: This thriller keeps readers guessing until the very last page.
thriller.example_zh: 这部惊悚小说让读者一直猜到最后一页。

thunderstorm.example_en: A heavy thunderstorm broke over the lake just after midnight.
thunderstorm.example_zh: 午夜刚过，一场大雷暴在湖面上爆发。

tin.example_en: He opened a tin of sweet peaches and shared them for dessert.
tin.example_zh: 他打开一罐甜桃，分给大家当甜点。

tiresome.example_en: Repeating the same safety drill every afternoon soon became tiresome.
tiresome.example_zh: 每天下午重复同样的安全演练，很快就令人厌烦。

translation.example_en: Her translation of the short poem keeps both its meaning and its rhythm.
translation.example_zh: 她翻译的这首短诗既保留了原意，也保留了节奏。

transparent.example_en: The plastic box is transparent, so you can see the gift inside.
transparent.example_zh: 这个塑料盒是透明的，所以你能看见里面的礼物。

tremble.example_en: His hands tremble whenever he has to speak before a large crowd.
tremble.example_zh: 每当必须在一大群人面前讲话时，他的双手就会发抖。

trolleybus.example_en: An old trolleybus glided quietly along the wide main street.
trolleybus.example_zh: 一辆旧式无轨电车沿着宽阔的主干道悄悄驶过。

troop.example_en: A troop of soldiers marched through the small town at dawn.
troop.example_zh: 黎明时分，一队士兵行军穿过小镇。

troublesome.example_en: A troublesome cough kept her awake for most of the night.
troublesome.example_zh: 一阵烦人的咳嗽让她夜里大部分时间都无法入睡。

tutor.example_en: My tutor meets me twice a week to practise spoken English.
tutor.example_zh: 我的辅导老师每周见我两次，练习英语口语。

typewriter.example_en: Grandfather still prefers to write personal letters on an old typewriter.
typewriter.example_zh: 祖父仍然喜欢用一台旧打字机写私人信件。

unbearable.example_en: The heat inside the crowded bus became unbearable by early afternoon.
unbearable.example_zh: 到了午后不久，拥挤的公共汽车里热得让人受不了。

unbelievable.example_en: It seemed unbelievable that such a small team could win the cup.
unbelievable.example_zh: 这样一支小球队竟能赢得奖杯，似乎令人难以置信。

unconditional.example_en: Their support for the child remained unconditional through every setback.
unconditional.example_zh: 无论遇到什么挫折，他们对孩子的支持始终是无条件的。

unconscious.example_en: He lay unconscious for several minutes after falling from the wall.
unconscious.example_zh: 他从墙上摔下来后，昏迷了好几分钟。

undertake.example_en: Our company will undertake the full repair of the old stone bridge.
undertake.example_zh: 我们公司将承担这座旧石桥的全部修缮工作。

underwear.example_en: Pack enough clean underwear in case the trip lasts longer than planned.
underwear.example_zh: 带上足够的干净内衣，以防行程比计划的更长。

unemployment.example_en: Local unemployment rose sharply after the main factory closed last winter.
unemployment.example_zh: 去年冬天主要工厂关闭后，当地失业率急剧上升。

unfortunate.example_en: It was unfortunate that the train left before they reached the platform.
unfortunate.example_zh: 不幸的是，他们赶到站台时火车已经开走了。

union.example_en: Factory workers formed a union to discuss wages, hours, and safety.
union.example_zh: 工厂工人成立了工会，以便讨论工资、工时和安全问题。

unite.example_en: Neighbors unite every spring to clean rubbish from the riverbank.
unite.example_zh: 邻居们每年春天都会联合起来，清理河岸上的垃圾。

unwilling.example_en: He seemed unwilling to lend his new bicycle to anyone at school.
unwilling.example_zh: 他似乎不愿意把新自行车借给学校里的任何人。

upward.example_en: An upward path led from the quiet village straight to the temple.
upward.example_zh: 一条向上的小路从安静的村庄直通寺庙。

upwards.example_en: Grey smoke drifted upwards from the chimney into the cold sky.
upwards.example_zh: 灰色的烟从烟囱向上飘进寒冷的天空。

vacant.example_en: Only one vacant seat remained beside the window on the bus.
vacant.example_zh: 公共汽车上靠窗的位置只剩一个空座。

vague.example_en: His vague answer left the whole group unsure about the real plan.
vague.example_zh: 他含糊其词的回答让全组的人都弄不清真正的计划。

vain.example_en: All their efforts to save the ancient tree proved to be in vain.
vain.example_zh: 他们拯救那棵古树的一切努力最终都白费了。

valid.example_en: Your passport must remain valid for at least six more months.
valid.example_zh: 你的护照剩余有效期必须至少还有六个月。

vertical.example_en: Please draw a vertical line through the exact center of the circle.
vertical.example_zh: 请画一条穿过圆心的垂直线。

via.example_en: We flew from London to Sydney via Dubai and arrived very late.
via.example_zh: 我们从伦敦经由迪拜飞往悉尼，到达时已经很晚了。

vice.example_en: Smoking slowly became a vice he found difficult to give up.
vice.example_zh: 吸烟渐渐成了他难以戒掉的恶习。

videophone.example_en: Grandma uses a videophone so she can see our faces while we talk.
videophone.example_zh: 奶奶使用可视电话，这样说话时她能看见我们的脸。

vinegar.example_en: Add one spoonful of vinegar to the soup if you want a brighter taste.
vinegar.example_zh: 如果想让味道更鲜，就往汤里加一勺醋。

violate.example_en: Cyclists who violate the red light put other road users at risk.
violate.example_zh: 闯红灯的骑行者会危及其他道路使用者。

violent.example_en: A violent coastal storm tore several roofs off houses near the harbour.
violent.example_zh: 一场猛烈的沿海风暴掀掉了港口附近几座房屋的屋顶。

visa.example_en: She waited nearly three weeks for her student visa before travelling.
visa.example_zh: 她等了将近三周才拿到学生签证，然后才动身。

voyage.example_en: Their voyage across the rough Atlantic took nearly two weeks.
voyage.example_zh: 他们横渡波涛汹涌的大西洋，航行了将近两周。

wag.example_en: The little dog began to wag its tail as soon as it saw her.
wag.example_zh: 那只小狗一看见她就开始摇尾巴。

waiting-room.example_en: Patients sat quietly in the waiting-room until a nurse called their names.
waiting-room.example_zh: 病人们安静地坐在候诊室里，直到护士叫到他们的名字。

walnut.example_en: She cracked a fresh walnut and scattered the pieces over the salad.
walnut.example_zh: 她敲开一颗新鲜核桃，把碎仁撒在沙拉上。

warehouse.example_en: Hundreds of boxed books were stored in a warehouse beside the river.
warehouse.example_zh: 数百箱图书存放在河边的一座仓库里。

warmth.example_en: The warmth of the kitchen fire soon dried our wet coats.
warmth.example_zh: 厨房炉火的温暖很快烘干了我们的湿外套。

wax.example_en: Honeybees use wax to build the tiny cells inside their hive.
wax.example_zh: 蜜蜂用蜡建造蜂巢里小小的巢室。

westward.example_en: The wide river flows westward until it finally reaches the sea.
westward.example_zh: 这条宽阔的河流向西奔去，直到最终入海。

whistle.example_en: The referee will whistle twice when the second half is about to start.
whistle.example_zh: 下半场即将开始时，裁判会吹两声哨。

widow.example_en: The elderly widow lived alone in a small house beside the church.
widow.example_zh: 这位年迈的寡妇独自住在教堂旁边的一所小房子里。

wipe.example_en: Please wipe the muddy shoes before you step onto the clean carpet.
wipe.example_zh: 踏上干净的地毯之前，请先把沾泥的鞋擦一擦。

worldwide.example_en: A worldwide shortage of grain pushed bread prices much higher.
worldwide.example_zh: 全球性的粮食短缺把面包价格推高了许多。

yell.example_en: Excited fans yell the player's name each time he scores a goal.
yell.example_zh: 每当那名球员进球，兴奋的球迷就大声喊他的名字。

yummy.example_en: The tomato soup smells yummy, and the children can hardly wait.
yummy.example_zh: 番茄汤闻起来真香，孩子们都快等不及了。

zipper.example_en: The zipper on my winter jacket stuck halfway and refused to move.
zipper.example_zh: 我冬季夹克上的拉链卡在半道，怎么也拉不动。

zoom.example_en: Fast cars zoom past our kitchen window every morning at rush hour.
zoom.example_zh: 每天早晨的高峰时段，汽车从我们厨房的窗前疾驰而过。
